name: Stathis 2018 IMGN529 exact, endpoint-probe, and exploratory calibrated scenarios
description: Complete exact evidence plus eight paper-endpoint probes and eight separately labelled exploratory aggregate calibrations.

scenarios.name: Complete article and supplement exact anchor
scenarios.description: Exact API replay of 377 numeric fields from Tables 1-5, Supplement Table S1, and source availability.

scenarios.name: 0.1 mg/kg paper-endpoint exponential probe
scenarios.description: Paper-endpoint probe initialized at the reported Cmax and eliminated with the reported half-life. It is not a paper-reported structural model.
